name: SheetStamp Labels – Barcode Labels for WooCommerce
author: dodsondevelopment1

sections.description:
Pick products, pick a label type, press Print. No account is needed.

  • Barcodes from the SKU, the GTIN/UPC/EAN field, a custom field or the product ID
  • Code 128, UPC-A, EAN-13, EAN-8, Code 39, ITF-14, QR code and Data Matrix
  • Automatic barcode type: valid UPC and EAN numbers print as retail barcodes, everything else as Code 128
  • Avery 5160, 5163, 5167, L7160 and L7163 sheets, common thermal roll sizes, or your own custom size
  • Start part-way down a part-used sheet
  • Product name, price and an extra line (SKU or product ID) on each label
  • “Print barcode labels” bulk action on the Products list and the Orders list (one label per unit ordered)
  • Works with variations and with High-Performance Order Storage

Optional SheetStamp account

Connecting a SheetStamp account adds features that run on the SheetStamp service:

  • Exact-size PDF label files that print the same from any device
  • ZPL files for Zebra-compatible thermal printers
  • Invoice and packing slip PDFs on each order

The free plan includes 100 units a month. Paid plans raise the limit.

External services

This plugin can connect to the SheetStamp service to make PDF and ZPL files. Nothing is sent unless you use one of the features below.

  • Requesting an API key (Settings, “Email me a key”): the email address you enter is sent so the service can email you a key.
  • Download PDF / Download ZPL: for each label, the barcode value, product name, price text, extra line and quantity are sent, with the label size and your API key.
  • Invoice PDF / Packing slip PDF: the order number and date, store name and address, the customer’s billing and shipping address, line items, totals, payment and shipping method, the customer note and your API key are sent.
  • Plan and usage (Settings tab, when a key is saved): your API key is sent to read your plan and usage.
  • Change plan: you are redirected to Stripe to pay. See https://stripe.com/privacy

Service terms: https://api.sheetstamp.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://api.sheetstamp.com/privacy

Source code

Barcodes are drawn by bwip-js (MIT licence). The bundled file assets/js/bwip-js-min.js is the minified build of https://github.com/metafloor/bwip-js version 4.11.4; the readable source is in that repository.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Barcode labels.
  3. Open Settings to choose where the barcode value comes from and your default label type.
  4. Search for products, set quantities and press Print labels.

In the browser print dialog set Scale to 100%, Margins to None, and turn off headers and footers.
sections.faq:
The labels drift off the sheet

Check that the print scale is 100% (not “Fit to page”) and margins are None. If your printer still shifts the page, use a custom size in Settings and adjust the margins by a millimetre or two.

My barcode will not print

UPC-A needs 12 digits and EAN-13 needs 13, with a correct check digit. Leave the barcode type on Automatic and any other value prints as Code 128.

Which characters are supported in PDFs?

Latin, Greek and Cyrillic. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is not supported in PDF and ZPL files yet. Browser printing uses your computer’s fonts and supports any language.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.
  • Internal: renamed the custom field setting.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: invoices and packing slips no longer show a lone state or country code when the shop address is not filled in.
  • Fixed: error pages now return a 400 status so hosts do not replace them with a generic error page.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: browser printing failed when “show barcode text” was on.
  • Fixed: empty custom size fields were saved as zero.
  • Fixed: template menu could overflow its box.

1.0.0

  • First release.
